title: Wang Tingzhi 24-case corpus is replay-ready in part, but full expert replay remains blocked
research_question: What can the Wang Tingzhi case corpus support today, and what is still required before it can test expert-method fidelity?
before_state: A source-demonstrated expert case could be mistaken for a complete executable reasoning trace or for empirical predictive evidence.
result: At source checkpoint 11f9eedd6bfcb05e5d0fcb2f17327bc3c288de86, the readiness v0.2 snapshot reported retrieval_ready=24, action_selection_ready=24, full_expert_replay_ready=0 and full_chart_blocked=24. The later accepted Product #545 / PR #554 source-input reconstruction work evaluates 37 bounded candidates across the same 24 cases: 11 unique target-anchor matches, 6 multiple matches, 5 no matches, 2 source-incomplete cases and 0 engine-unsupported candidates. Eleven cases are eligible for a later full-chart materialization step, but the current Product state still names that materialization as next work; this does not complete full expert replay.
key_insights: Source case inventory, target-palace materialization, retrieval readiness, action-selection readiness, full expert replay, method fidelity and predictive validity are separate maturity stages.
The blind evidence layer intentionally materializes only source-visible target-palace major-star facts; it does not reconstruct all 24 full charts.
Source subject names, expert prose, conclusions, outcomes and external biography are excluded from the blind view to reduce benchmark leakage.
The live Product state names WANG_METHOD_SCOPE_AND_FULL_CHART_REVIEW as the next work unit; the Sidecar does not execute that Product work.

The later source-input reconstruction result supersedes the earlier 24/24 full-chart-blocked readiness count only for eligibility to materialize: 11/24 are now eligible for a later materialization step, not already materialized or fully source-chart verified.
negative_findings: Full expert replay readiness is 0/24 in the cited readiness record.
The corpus does not yet provide a method-fidelity score or predictive-validity result.
At the later checkpoint, 13/24 cases remain withheld from full-chart materialization: 6 ambiguous, 5 no-anchor-match and 2 source-incomplete.

boundaries.source_status: Source-backed corpus acceptance and readiness counters are explicit in accepted main artifacts.
boundaries.implementation_status: At the captured 11f9 checkpoint, no full charts were materialized. Later accepted source reconstruction makes 11 cases eligible for a subsequent materialization step; actual materialization and full expert replay remain separate work.
boundaries.internal_fidelity: Readiness only; not an expert-replay fidelity score.
boundaries.empirical_status: No prospective or replicated predictive evidence.

artifacts.label: Product lane state cache
artifacts.note: State cache itself says it is as of an earlier Product commit; live issues and accepted main artifacts remain authoritative.

authority_notes: Do not describe the 24-case corpus as an executed blind benchmark. Product state is a recovery cache with its own as-of commit; current live Issues/PRs remain execution truth. This historical event is superseded on the source-reconstruction readiness dimension by RM-2026-009; the conclusion that full expert replay is not yet ready remains current.
